limitations: Categories are populated only where the ta-v1/fa-v1 semantic analysis has run (analysis-ready-adjacent codes), a small and non-random slice of the corpus. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Boxplot of robust_z grouped by topic, groups with fewer than 5 videos dropped, top 12 groups by size shown, outlier points hidden for readability.
title: Topic vs performance
